newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mobil Singapore mulls refinery turnaround in Q1'97.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Singapore mulls refinery turnaround in Q1'97.

text.p: Mobil Oil Singapore, a unit of Mobil Corp, is considering closing its 280,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery for maintenance at the end of the the first quarter 1997, an industry source said on Wednesday.
"It is quite a widespread shutdown but it is quite normal since there has not been a major refinery turnaround for a few years already," the source said.
But the source also said plans were still at an initial stage and would only be finalised in a month's time.
However he noted that if margins were good, Mobil might not carry out the turnaround at that time.
Weak refining margins forced Mobil to cut runs at its Jurong refinery by 10,000-bpd from mid-June to late August.
Mobil's last scheduled shutdown was in end November last year of a 40,000-bpd crude distillation unit and a 86,000-bpd vacuum distillation unit for seven days.
